data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Elettra is the goddess of the dawn and the east wind. She is the daughter of Helios, the god of the sun, and is often depicted carrying a torch or a crown of rays. The name Elettra carries the meaning “Goddess of the East” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elettra usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the east and live with faith, good character and purpose.
